An internal Claude model just found a proof of the algebraic analogue of P vs NP, known as Valiant’s conjecture

Claude is credited as the author of the 70-page paper and the Lean proof passed automated checks.

If you remember the determinant of a 2×2 matrix, it’s ad − bc. Change it to ad + bc and you get the “permanent.” The same idea works for larger matrices. Streamer MoistCr1TiKaL says Rockstar Games should have delayed GTA 6 on consoles until the PC version was ready, and claims the studio held back PC on purpose as a double dip scheme to sell the game twice:

“Like I understand with the level of content this game has, with everything in it, it was not feasible to achieve a steady solid 60fps on console, which is why my preference would have been to have all the platforms release at the same time.”

“I would have pushed the console releases back until the PC version was ready so that way people can truly have the freedom to choose where they want to play it.”

“So if you are someone that does really value 60 fps, well then you'd get it on PC, right?”

“But the reason they didn't do that is obvious, so they can double dip.”

“So that way people will buy it again on PC for the 60 fps, for the modding, for like RP when that comes out with those servers and everything, when all of that's in full effect.”

“It's a monetization model, that's part of the scheme, and it's successful, like it's going to work.”

posts.text:
Spent 15 years in Norway. I pay up to 47% in taxes and this is what I get back. 🇳🇴

Education for child till Master's: free.

Hospital bill ₹1 lakh or ₹10 crore: you pay zero.

Parents gets ₹2.3 lakh a year from the government for every child until the age of 18. Tax free.

Child birth: Mother gets 1 year of leave with paid salary. Father gets 4 months of leave with paid salary.

You fall sick: full salary from day one until you recover. 

You lose Job: you are safe, you salary is paid by government until you get new job. 

Summer holiday: you get one month paid summer vacation.

Plus mountains, forests, ocean and fjords. 

Clean air, tap water, clean roads, all electric cars , no pollution and a healthy lifestyle.

Pension fund: ₹3.6 crore for every person in Norway. You get full pension after retirement. 

The catch: up to 47% tax, and it gets dark at 3:30 pm in the winter. But In summer Norway feels like heaven, and you get northern Lights and snow in the winter.

Now the questioin is... How much tax do we pay in India, and what do we get back?
